title: The kb_tools MCP tool, one AGENTS.md line and kb_ask.py's routing send a which-tool question to the catalog
goal: the kb MCP server lists a read-only kb_tools tool (need, optional) that returns kbtools.py's lines; AGENTS.md names kbtools.py as the first step when an agent does not know which tool answers, staying within its 4096-byte cap by a cut elsewhere; kb_ask.py --route maps a which-tool or how-do-I question (fixed cue words, as mon_status.topic_of does) to kind=tools and answers it with kbtools.py, no pack and no model

run:
import subprocess, sys
mcp = open('_tools/kb_mcp.py', encoding='utf-8').read().replace('"', "'")
agents = open('AGENTS.md', encoding='utf-8').read()
route = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '_tools/kb_ask.py', '--route', 'which tool shows how long each landing step took'],
                       capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
ok = "'kb_tools'" in mcp and 'kbtools.py' in agents and len(agents.encode('utf-8')) <= 4096 and 'kind=tools' in route
print('mcp kb_tools', "'kb_tools'" in mcp, '| AGENTS.md names kbtools.py', 'kbtools.py' in agents, '| route:', route.strip()[:120])
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)

notes: Premise: kb_ask.py --route 'which tool shows how long each landing step took' plans kind=split with model=sonnet (a paid researcher) although backlog.py landings answers it; 36 _tools command-line tools exist and none carries Answers: or Use: lines; tools.md, the one table of tools, is too long to read whole, so agents iterate over files. The AGENTS.md cap (4096 bytes, tested) means the line replaces another.
